items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle, who has been dealing with a chest injury that he aggravated last week, is trending in the right direction to play, source says.
items.why: Source update Sunday morning; trending positive after aggravation.
items.implication: Likely plays; reverse any prior fade if confirmed active.
items.opportunity: Full routes if cleared; DEN WR hierarchy stabilizes.
items.conflict: Berry HATE on tough KC matchup.

items.text: Broncos officially placed RB R.J. Harvey on short-term IR after knee injury in Thursday practice; will miss next four games, eligible return Dec. 6 vs Dolphins.
items.why: Knee injury suffered in practice; short-term IR confirmed by team and sources.
items.implication: Removes unique receiving back role; 3-6 targets freed in Broncos offense.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets/carries for remaining DEN backs; no clean handcuff per analysts.

items.text: Patriots ruling out WR A.J. Brown and RB TreVeyon Henderson for Sunday’s game vs. the Dolphins.
items.why: Knee/ankle for Brown; illness for Henderson; official ruling.
items.implication: Volume shift to remaining NE pass-catchers and Rhamondre Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for NE WRs/TEs; Stevenson receiving bump vs MIA.

items.text: Shocked Saquon Barkley (hamstring, back) wasn't on final injury report. Hard to believe he's 100%, but he's playing.
items.why: No designation on final report despite recent hamstring/back issues and limited practice.
items.implication: Surprising IN; usage may still be managed/limited snaps.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone work if full; reverse prior beneficiary expectations for backups.
items.conflict: Berry hates/fades Barkley on usage concerns despite IN.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (foot) after clearing concussion; projections updated for outs including Egbuka/Tate/Spears/AJB/Harvey.
items.why: Foot injury prevents return despite concussion clearance; final report.
items.implication: TB WR targets redistribute; Godwin and others elevated.
items.opportunity: Snap/route/target share increase for remaining Bucs receivers.

items.text: Seahawks running backs Jadarian Price and Zach Charbonnet have no injury designations for Monday night and both are now expected to play against the Bears. This will be Charbonnet’s season debut.
items.why: No designations; cleared for MNF after IR return process.
items.implication: Crowded SEA backfield with Walker/Charbonnet/Price; committee likely.
items.opportunity: Monitor snap shares; Price may see limited early work.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) for second straight; Dontayvion Wicks also OUT. Goedert elevated as top target.
items.why: Lingering hamstring; DNP and ruled out on final report.
items.implication: Eagles WR room thin; TE and remaining WRs see target bump with Hurts out season-long.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Goedert; red-zone opportunity.

items.text: Carnell Tate OUT (shoulder); Wan'Dale Robinson and others see opportunity with Titans pass-catchers depleted. Projections updated.
items.why: Shoulder; DNP and ruled out on final report alongside Spears.
items.implication: Titans WR volume concentrates on remaining options like Robinson/Ridley.
items.opportunity: Higher target share and routes for Wan'Dale Robinson; cheap WR volume play.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) isn't on final report, but we do have some smallish docks on his rushing. Full practice week.
items.why: Full practices, no designation after missing three games with high ankle sprain.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense; slight rush yardage dock but elite QB1 upside vs Bills.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for Flowers; improved script for Henry.

items.text: Thought Breece Hall (quad) was close to playing last week. Now we get cryptic tweets and another Q tag.
items.why: Limited practice, cryptic updates; returning from multi-week quad issue.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT, Allen sees full work; if IN, shared backfield.
items.opportunity: Monitor inactive window; potential split or limited carries/routes.
items.conflict: Berry loves Hall/Allen stack vs LV if active.

items.text: RJ Harvey's (knee) role is so unique, don't think he has a clean replacement. But 3-6 more targets now available. Also Jaylen Waddle (chest) is Q.
items.why: Unique role observed in usage; no clear handcuff identified in projections update.
items.implication: Target bump for other DEN pass-catchers and backs; monitor Waddle status closely.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets expansion for remaining skill players; Waddle Q impacts DEN WR hierarchy.

items.text: Saquon Barkley HATE/RB20 @ WSH; usage concerns and recent injuries (hamstring/back) despite surprising IN.
items.why: Limited snaps recently; pitch count risk and back issue.
items.implication: Fade or bench; lower volume expected.
items.conflict: Levitan notes shocked he's fully off report and playing.

items.text: Zay Flowers LOVE/WR5; Lamar unlock in track-meet Bills-Ravens game. Targeted on 48% of routes when Lamar plays.
items.why: High target rate with Lamar; soft/high-scoring matchup environment.
items.implication: Strong WR1 upside; stack with Lamar/Henry.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle HATE/WR30 vs KC; secondary makes life miserable for WRs.
items.why: Tough KC pass defense; recent chest injury aggravation adds risk.
items.implication: Fade even if active; lower floor/ceiling.
items.conflict: Rapoport trending positive to play; Levitan notes Q.

items.text: Derrick Henry LOVE/RB6 @ BUF; history vs Buffalo and Lamar return improves outlook despite tough run D on paper.
items.why: Favorable scoring environment; Lamar upgrade to offense.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/carries volume with better QB play.

items.text: Chase Brown LOVE/RB8 vs TEN; due for TD luck against weak run defense.
items.why: Soft matchup; positive game script as favorite.
items.opportunity: Carries + receiving work in pass-heavy CIN offense.

items.text: Josh Jacobs LOVE/RB11 vs CAR; Panthers defense nightmare for backs, Jacobs back in mix.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor run D; returning healthy role.
items.implication: RB1/2 upside; inside-5 and target work.
items.conflict: NFL reviewing additional allegations (Schefter) but no status impact yet.

items.text: Joe Burrow LOVE/QB2 vs TEN; high-scoring environment, pass-heavy offense vs weak D.
items.why: Huge team total potential; TEN defense vulnerable.
